data.name: Interstellar Void
data.description: You call upon the frigid depths of outer space to bring a terrible chill to your enemies. As a standard action

raw_tokens.value: You call upon the frigid depths of outer space to bring a terrible chill to your enemies. As a standard action

one target within 30 feet is cloaked in the void and takes %1d%2 points of cold damage. A successful Fortitude save (DC %3) halves this damage. You can use this ability %4/day.|InterstellarVoidDice|InterstellarVoidDieType|InterstellarVoidDC|InterstellarVoidTimes|!PRECLASS:1,Oracle=10

one target within 30 feet is cloaked in the void and takes %1d%2 points of cold damage and is fatigued. A successful Fortitude save (DC %3) halves this damage. You can use this ability %4/day.|InterstellarVoidDice|InterstellarVoidDieType|InterstellarVoidDC|InterstellarVoidTimes|PREMULT:2,[!PRECLASS:1,Oracle=15],[PRECLASS:1,Oracle=10]

one target within 30 feet is cloaked in the void and takes %1d%2 points of cold damage and is exhausted and stunned for 1 round. A successful Fortitude save (DC %3) halves this damage. You can use this ability %4/day.|InterstellarVoidDice|InterstellarVoidDieType|InterstellarVoidDC|InterstellarVoidTimes|PRECLASS:1,Oracle=15
